The first downloadable build of Arcane Dome: Milestone 1 plus a round of playtest polish. Very early: placeholder art, no sound yet.

## Download and play

- **Windows:** download `arcane-dome-v0.1.1-windows-x86_64.zip`, unzip it, run `arcane-dome.exe`.
- **Linux:** download `arcane-dome-v0.1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, unpack it, run `./arcane-dome`. Needs the usual desktop libraries (ALSA, X11, Xi, OpenGL), which most desktops already have.

Keep the `assets` folder next to the game.

## What's in it

- 3 maps: Foundry Ascent, Frostline Relay (built for 3 and 4 teams) and Redstone Arches (built for 2 teams)
- Deathmatch and Elimination, free-for-all or 2 to 4 teams with pickable colours
- Elimination styles: Rounds, Last Man Standing and Attrition
- Every limit can be turned off, even all of them for an endless match
- 10 weapons, 4 powerups, thrusters, weapon and shield stations
- Bots with three difficulties, set per team
- 3 second countdown, 5 second respawn, 3 second spawn protection

## Controls

Move A/D, jump W or Space (twice to double jump), crouch S, press S on a hatch to drop through, aim and fire with the mouse, reload R, weapons 1 to 0 / Q E / wheel, Shadowstep F, scoreboard Tab, pause P or Esc.

Inspired by the Raze series by JuiceTin and AddisonR; not affiliated with them. See CREDITS.md.
